one_liner.zh: 本周加密走出相对独立路径：BTC 窗口约 -3.1%、偏震荡，杠杆中性；实现波动处低位而期权相对 RV 偏贵；美现货 BTC ETF 呈温和流出（周净约 -3.90 亿美金），与小幅回落的现货成交额并陈。
one_liner.en: Crypto traced a relatively idiosyncratic path this week: BTC roughly -3.1% on the window in chop, leverage neutral; realized vol stayed low while options looked rich versus RV; US spot BTC ETFs saw mild outflow (weekly net about -390M USD), set beside softer spot turnover.

zh: BTC ETF 周净流 -3.90 亿美金

risk.zh: 低 RV 与偏高 IV 溢价仍是主摩擦；杠杆侧风险不高——清算峰弱且与 OI 高点分离。流出是否加长、溢价能否收窄，优先于杠杆踩踏叙事。
risk.en: Low RV under rich IV remains the main friction; leverage risk is modest — mild liq peak separated from OI highs. Whether outflows lengthen and premium compresses outranks any cascade narrative.

watch.zh: 盯 ETF 净流与 IV−RV 溢价；杠杆侧轻核：是否出现清算峰与 OI 日高同日（本周没有）。加密相对股指独立性格局是否延续。
watch.en: Watch ETF nets and IV−RV premium; light leverage check: whether liq peak aligns same day with OI daily high (absent this week). Whether crypto’s idiosyncratic stance vs equities persists.

vol_premium.zh: 期权偏贵（IV 相对 RV 溢价）

compare.zh: BTC 窗口约 -3.1%、ETH 约 -1.8%，同期 ES 小涨、NQ 约 +1.0%，VIX 回落；美元与金亦偏稳偏正。标签落在「加密偏独立」：方向与弹性并未与美股风险资产同步，更像加密内部供需与仓位节奏在主导。
compare.en: BTC about -3.1% and ETH about -1.8% on the window, while ES edged up and NQ gained roughly +1.0% with VIX lower; dollar and gold were mildly constructive. The label is crypto-idiosyncratic: direction and beta did not track US risk assets, pointing more to crypto-native flow and positioning.

path.zh: 路径标签为偏震荡：周内并非单边趋势腿，而是在温和负收益中完成高低切换；清算峰值在窗口首日（8/10）且与 OI 周高（8/14）错开，其后未再现极端清算簇，更符合震荡消化而非杠杆出清主导。
path.en: Path labeled chop: mild negative week with high/low rotation, not a trend leg; liq peak on window day-one (8/10) staggered from OI week high (8/14), no extreme liq cluster after — digestion, not flush-led.

leverage.zh:
标签：杠杆中性。
① 拥挤线：funding 约 +8.2%/yr → +4.2%/yr 回落；OI 周变约 +3.7%（107052 → 110963）——库存升但租金降，非「贵而疯加」，也非清算主导去库存。
② 出清线：清算峰相对温和（约 1.5× 中位），峰日 08-10（笔数与 qty 同日）；当日 OI 反为周内偏低（约 106300），OI 周高在 08-14（约 112008）——峰与 OI 高点分离，峰日也未见 OI 冲顶式双高。出清线不主导本周。
③ 量旁证：永续约 409 亿美金，WoW 约 −12%，活跃度中性略缩。
收句：中性成立——无强双高、无强挤压标签所需的出清主导；拥挤线与出清线都偏淡，勿硬造挤压故事。不归因涨跌。
leverage.en:
Label: leverage neutral.
① Crowding: funding ~+8.2%/yr → ~+4.2%/yr; OI +3.7% week (107052 → 110963) — inventory up while rent cooled; neither “dear and frantic add” nor liq-led de-stocking.
② Flush: mild liq peak (~1.5× median) on 08-10 (count and qty same day); that day’s OI was near week lows (~106300) while OI week high was 08-14 (~112008) — peak separated from OI high, no dual-high spike day. Flush line does not dominate.
③ Volume: perp ~40.9B USD, WoW ~−12%, activity normal-to-soft.
Close: neutral holds — no strong dual-high, no flush-dominated squeeze case; both crowding and flush stayed mild — do not force a squeeze story. No price causation.

etf.zh: 美现货 BTC ETF 合计净申赎约 -3.90 亿美金（通道：温和流出；约 1 入 4 出，单日最深流出落在 8/10），ETH ETF 合计约 -2.26 百万美金、近乎持平。并陈 Binance 口径 BTC 现货成交额周合约 46.76 亿美金、环比约 -4.9%，总量热闹度正常偏淡——净流与现货周转只作并列观察，不焊死涨跌因果。
etf.en: US spot BTC ETFs posted about -390M USD net (channel: mild outflow; roughly 1 inflow vs 4 outflow days, deepest daily print on Aug 10); ETH ETFs about -2.26M USD, nearly flat. Alongside, BTC spot turnover (exchange sum) about 4.68B USD for the week, ~-4.9% WoW—normal-to-soft heat. Net flow and spot turnover are juxtaposed only; no welded price causality.

spot_volume.zh: Binance 现货成交额（turnover 美金，程序周合计）：本周 46.76 亿美金，相对上完整周 -4.8%（活跃度「中性」；上周约 49.14 亿美金）。峰值日 2026-08-10（8.81 亿美金）。这是交易所现货「换手热闹程度」，与 ETF 净申赎同属现货世界、只并陈；对照永续周成交额 408.99 亿美金——两者量级不同，**禁止相加**，也**不能**拆多空。
spot_volume.en: Binance spot turnover (USD, program week sum): this week 4.68B, vs prior full week -4.8% (activity “normal”; prior ~4.91B). Peak day 2026-08-10 (880.50M). Spot tape busyness beside ETF net flow — same spot world, no sum with perp (40.90B); not a long/short split.

vol_teach.zh: RV 量的是已走过的起伏，IV 是市场对未来起伏的要价。本周 RV 低、IV 明显更高，等于「过去很安静、保单仍不便宜」；在震荡标签下，这种溢价常对应卖方有 thrift 空间、买方要付更高时间成本——是否可持续，看下一周 RV 是否抬头或 IV 是否松动。
vol_teach.en: RV measures realized swings; IV is the market’s asking price for future ones. Low RV under clearly higher IV means ‘the past was quiet, insurance still isn’t cheap.’ In a chop regime that premium often favors thrifty sellers and costs buyers more time decay—sustainability hinges on whether RV wakes up or IV eases next week.

vol_week.zh: BTC 实现波动年化约 10.0%（低波动标签），期末 Deribit IV 约 35.2%，IV-RV 点差约 +25.1 个百分点，落在「期权偏贵」。ETH RV 约 15.6%、IV 约 47.5%，同样偏贵结构。价格小跌、实现波不动声色，但期权曲面仍要溢价。
vol_week.en: BTC realized vol ~10.0% ann. (low-vol tag) versus end Deribit IV ~35.2%, IV–RV spread ~+25.1 points—options rich. ETH RV ~15.6% with IV ~47.5%, same rich structure. Price eased quietly while realized stayed muted, yet the options surface still charged a premium.

vol_combo.zh: 低 RV + IV 偏贵 + 价格偏震荡，组合出「波动已实现的少、被定价的多」。对喜欢收溢价的结构更合拍，对依赖趋势波动爆发的路径则空气偏稀；与杠杆中性、永续活跃度环比下滑一致，市场并未用高杠杆去「制造」波动。
vol_combo.en: Low RV + rich IV + choppy price yields ‘little realized, plenty priced.’ That fits premium-harvest structures better than paths that need trend-vol expansion; it aligns with neutral leverage and softer perp activity—the market did not lever up to manufacture vol.

vol_price_iv.zh: 价格周线小负、IV 仍显著高于 RV：下跌并未换来实现波的显著抬升，也未迫使 IV 大幅塌陷，溢价 accordingly 挂着。若后续续跌而 RV 仍钝，偏贵标签可能更刺眼；若反弹仍窄幅，IV 有无松绑是下一观察切口。
vol_price_iv.en: Mildly negative price week while IV stayed well above RV: the dip did not lift realized vol much nor force a sharp IV collapse, so the premium hung. Further downside with still-dull RV would make richness more glaring; a narrow rebound would put the focus on whether IV loosens.

vol_vix.zh: VIX 窗口约 -4.4%，美股波动要价回落；加密侧 BTC IV 却仍对低 RV 维持厚溢价。传统与加密波动定价本周并未同向松紧，强化「加密偏独立」的波动叙事而非风险 appetite 的简单镜像。
vol_vix.en: VIX roughly -4.4% on its bracket—equity vol asking price eased—while crypto BTC IV still held a thick premium over low RV. TradFi and crypto vol pricing did not loosen in lockstep, reinforcing an idiosyncratic vol story rather than a simple risk-appetite mirror.

tradfi_summary.zh: 美股括号内 ES 约 +0.3%、NQ 约 +1.0%，VIX 回落；DXY 近乎走平，美债 10Y 约 +3.6 bp，黄金约 +0.9%。风险资产偏温和修复、股指波动降温，与加密的小幅回撤、偏贵期权形成对照，本周主线更像板块内生而非全球 beta 一键拖拽。
tradfi_summary.en: In the US session bracket ES ~+0.3%, NQ ~+1.0%, VIX lower; DXY nearly flat, US10Y ~+3.6 bp, gold ~+0.9%. Mild equity repair and cooler equity vol contrasted with crypto’s modest pullback and rich options—more sector-native than a global-beta drag.

three_conclusions.zh: 加密相对股指偏独立：BTC/ETH 小幅收负，ES/NQ 温和收正、VIX 下行，本周主矛盾是板块内生而非全球风险开关。
three_conclusions.en: Crypto stayed idiosyncratic versus equities: BTC/ETH mildly negative while ES/NQ finished softly green and VIX fell—the week’s tension was sector-native, not a global risk on/off.

three_conclusions.zh: 波动结构拧巴：实现波动低、IV 相对 RV 明显溢价，价格震荡却买不到「便宜的未来波动」。
three_conclusions.en: Vol structure was twisted: realized low, IV clearly rich to RV—choppy price without cheap forward vol.

three_conclusions.zh: 现货通道与杠杆并列：BTC ETF 周净约 -3.90 亿美金（温和流出），现货成交额约 46.8 亿、环比略降；杠杆中性、永续周转环比下滑，杠杆与通道都未显示过热。
three_conclusions.en: Spot channel beside leverage: BTC ETF weekly net about -390M USD (mild outflow), spot turnover ~4.68B slightly down WoW; leverage neutral and perp turnover softer—neither channel nor gear looked overheated.

text.en: Whether BTC’s IV–RV spread stays richly above ~20 points or compresses meaningfully.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周低 RV 配高 IV 是核心结构矛盾，溢价能否松动决定 vol_harvest 叙事是否续写。

text.zh: 加密相对 ES/NQ 的收益差是否继续呈现「股强币弱/独立」而非重新同步。
text.en: Whether crypto’s return gap versus ES/NQ keeps looking equity-strong/crypto-soft (idiosyncratic) rather than resynchronizing.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周 tradfi_link 为加密偏独立，是下期核对 beta 是否回归的清晰命题。

matched.zh: 匹配 mean_reversion：趋势标签偏震荡、周收益有限且路径非单边，利于回归类逻辑而非追突破。匹配 vol_harvest：RV 低而 IV-RV 溢价厚，波动卖方/收溢价结构与「实现少、定价多」的周性格局同向；二者都建立在中性杠杆与未爆发的清算簇之上。
matched.en: Matched mean_reversion: chop label, limited weekly return, non-trending path—favors reversion over breakout chase. Matched vol_harvest: low RV under a thick IV–RV premium aligns with premium-selling / harvest structures in a ‘little realized, plenty priced’ week; both sit on neutral leverage without liquidation cascades.

mismatched.zh: 错配 trend_following：偏震荡与约 -3% 的窗口更像区间消耗，缺乏可持续方向腿与波动扩张配合；在 ETF 温和流出、永续活跃度环比下滑的背景下，趋势仓更易吃假突破与时间摩擦。
mismatched.en: Mismatched trend_following: chop plus a roughly -3% window reads as range digestion, lacking a durable directional leg and vol expansion; with mild ETF outflow and softer perp activity, trend books are more exposed to false breaks and time friction.
